propositions: Commit bodies on main are inconsistently wrapped (5 of last 40 commits pass 50/72 rule, 35 fail with body lines ranging 177-286 characters)
A local commit-msg hook must reject commits with subjects exceeding 50 characters or body lines exceeding 72 characters, while preserving Gerrit's Change-Id stamping

Exemptions from the 72-character limit must be detected for trailers (^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*:\s), tags (^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*=), fenced code blocks (^\s*```), indented blocks (≥4 spaces or tab), table rows (^\|), and atomic tokens containing ://, path separators, or dotted identifiers
The check-only script must never rewrite commit messages and must ignore git scaffolding (comment lines and --verbose diff after >8 marker)
Gerrit's existing commit-msg hook must remain functional via pre-commit's migration mode (commit-msg.legacy) with verification that Change-Id chaining survives
